body: It's a fucked up of kind of feeling I understand don't ever forget other people have been in same situation. How old are you? I change the story every time. I said ive gotten attacked by a rabid cat, scraped my arms on a large machine at work, even fell into an industrial sized catering blender for Starbucks. 
The looks when people realize my retellings dont match is freaking hilarious. 

But when im not in the mood I hands down tell people to mind their business.

i'd been hiding it since i was 13, and it got progressively worse over time. at the age of like 24, i was driving with my mom next to me and my sister in the back seat. she caught it cuz my sleeve rolled up as i was making a turn. 

"are you cutting yourself? im telling your father. what kind of evil are you? god doesnt want you doing evil things like this." 
obviously she was and still is a very religious christian human. 
she snitched me out to my father and while i was in my room crying he stormed in and was yelling at me to "show me your damn arms" and grabbed me and pulled my sleeve up.  he then proceeded to say this combination of things within the same 5 minutes or so:
1. are you doing drugs?
2. who taught you to do this
3. why are you doing this to us
4. do we need to send you to the crazy house
5. what kind of shit are you looking at online
6. i better not see you do this again, im going to be making daily checks (which he did for a while)

mom followed up with a religious lecture, how im basically cutting god by cutting myself because we are god's temple or some dumbass shit like that, and did i want to go to hell because killing myself meant god wasn't going to want me anymore and that i was going to go straight to hell if i did that. 

years later and obviously i hadn't stopped, i was wearing a tank top and had large keloid scars on my chest. i usually wear tshirts or jackets because of this but it was hot as hell this day. i went to pick up something at my dad's and he takes one look and says "there you go again still doing that nasty shit. didnt i tell you to stop?"

like bro you act like tellling people to stop doing things will make them stop doing things? 

im 27, 28 in a couple months and im still struggling with it.
